svg.title: Wollastonite phase fraction during SBF immersion for ceramics sintered at 700 to 1100 °C
svg.desc: Top row: wollastonite weight percent versus SBF immersion time, one panel per sintering temperature. Bottom row: change relative to day 0.
svg.text: Wollastonite in SBF: sintering temperature sets both the starting point and the trajectory
Wollastonite fraction vs immersion time per sintering temperature · top: absolute · bottom: change relative to day 0
Filled marker = |Δ| beyond an assumed ±2 wt% XRD uncertainty (shaded band); open marker = within it
Mass-loss kinetics (power-law fit): 700 °C, n = 0.25 (quasi-Fickian); 1100 °C, n = 0.58 (anomalous transport).
Wollastonite fraction is set mainly by sintering temperature; after day 3 it varies by less than 1.7 wt% (day 3–21) at every temperature.
Single series per temperature, no replicate errors; the shaded band is an assumed illustration, not a measured uncertainty.
